A cross-sectional diagram of a hydroelectric dam. On the left, a large reservoir of water held back by a thick concrete dam wall. A tunnel (penstock) slopes down through the dam to a turbine with blades. The turbine is connected by a vertical shaft to a generator in a powerhouse above. Water flows out the right side into the lower river.

A diagram showing a simple photovoltaic cell. Sunlight (wavy yellow arrows pointing down) strikes the top layer of a rectangular silicon wafer. Inside the wafer, small circles representing electrons are knocked loose and flow through an external wire attached to the top and bottom layers, passing through a lightbulb that is glowing.
